releaseNotes:
SAM 0.12.20 replaces live support chat with a trackable support case workflow.

- Contact support now collects your name, contact email and the specific installed Autodesk design program affected, then submits a case emailed directly to Synergysoft Support with your email set as the reply-to address.
- My support cases shows every case you've submitted, its current status (New, Accepted, In progress, Waiting for customer, Resolved), and Synergysoft's latest update — refreshed automatically while the window is open.
- Submitting a case twice from a dropped connection no longer creates a duplicate; retry safely.
- Previous conversations from the old chat system remain visible as read-only history on existing tickets.
- Local software detection remains every five seconds; heartbeat remains every ten minutes; remote support remains every two minutes.
- Includes all prior monitoring and request-reduction fixes from 0.12.19.

Requires the updated SAM backend supporting /api/agent/support-cases. Older clients using the previous chat endpoints will see a notice that support has moved to the new case system instead of a silent failure.
